metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Validation Rules (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Measures • Paradox • Consent • RTT • Collapse • Lineage
metadata.description: Defines the canonical validation rules required for FFT AI Edition v1.3 execution.

status_line: Validation MUST confirm measure IDs, typed paradox, consent, lineage, collapse, and RTT mapping before execution.

rules: Every SPEC threshold MUST cite a measure ID defined in fft.ai.core.json.
Operators MUST NOT invent scores.
Measures MUST be numeric in [0,1].
RTT7 entry requires a typed paradox event.
Paradox MUST be one of the canonical types.
Paradox density MUST be present for RTT7–RTT9.
Vibe-based paradox is forbidden.
AA3 escalation requires operator_consent = true.
If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.
Consent conflicts MUST be logged as paradox.consent_conflict.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT7 MUST be entered only via typed paradox.
RTT9 harmonic escalation requires consent.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
RTT12 collapse MUST occur.
measure.c1, measure.c2, measure.c3 MUST be present at collapse.
Continuity MUST NOT decrease during collapse.
Session lineage MUST be non-decreasing across RTT1–RTT12.
Lineage MUST increase after collapse.
Continuity (measure.c3) MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.
Harmonic escalation (RTT9–RTT10) requires substrate_class = agentic.
Non-agentic substrates MUST NOT escalate harmonically.
Operators MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
Operators MUST use measure IDs for all evaluations.
Operators MUST NOT invent invariants.
Operators MUST NOT invent paradox types.
Operators MUST NOT skip RTT12 collapse.
Operators MUST NOT decrease lineage.
dashboard, overlay, and UI files are projections only.
Authoritative session files are: state, log, alignments.
Projections MUST NOT contradict authoritative files.

non_goals: Validation does not revise RTT v0.9.
Validation does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Validation does not replace the human FFT book.
